Notes: Five-menu acceptance fixes: preserve unsaved Inventory and CVE editors; reject all duplicate Excel IDs/serials; scope Cisco neighbor parsing to CDP/LLDP commands and review contradictory endpoint identities; clear obsolete configuration differences and explicitly reanalyze legacy captures with verified hashes. Collector distinguishes banner text from waiting interactive prompts. CVE requests bound body reads, retain NVD when optional KEV fails, and refresh expired assessments before approval/export. Real-device and human acceptance remain open.

All current menus now have functional workflows. Added actual-data Dashboard, stable-ID MA Inventory with versioned Excel preview/import and edit audit, hash-verified Cisco observations and one-hop Topology with capture comparison. Added NVD/CISA metadata, explicit engineer applicability review and evidence-linked device upgrade plans with Excel/CSV/HTML export. No discovery, automatic vulnerability verdict, device upgrade execution or plaintext secrets. Real-device and human acceptance remain open.

Terminal now asks to accept a new SSH host key instead of requiring manual fingerprint input. Accept Once, Accept & Save, recognize saved hosts, review changed keys and manage saved keys. Host-key review pauses the connection timer; credentials remain memory-only.

Real offline ANSI/xterm Terminal with five SSH/Telnet tabs, SHA-256 host pins, password/OpenSSH-key authentication, guarded paste, zoom and nonsecret profiles. Sessions persist across navigation and drain on Exit/update. Owned fixtures verified; real devices, Serial/SFTP and manual Windows acceptance remain open.

• Config Collector now collects from explicit device lists using verified SSH or explicitly enabled Telnet.
• Added memory-only AUTH1/AUTH2, restricted fallback, immutable run options and prompt-aware read-only commands.
• Stream protected TXT/JSON captures with hashes, bounded preview, cancellation and error CSV.
• Uses the existing Light/Dark/System theme, resizable tables/panels and Ctrl+wheel result zoom.
• Tested with owned SSH/Telnet loopback fixtures; real Cisco and other vendor acceptance remains open.

• Added local Monitoring for up to 50 configured devices: ICMP/TCP, SNMP v1/v2c/v3, Test SNMP, selected interfaces/bandwidth, custom OIDs and bounded incidents.
• Previously started monitors resume on startup; X hides to System Tray, explicit Exit/update drains work, and sleep/network gaps remain distinct from device downtime.
• Renamed Subnet Calculator; optional IPv6 DNS servers and wrapped/resizable answers; MAC/ARP text and same-line IP mapping are processed after Check.
• Added protected VirusTotal key configuration and existing-report API lookup, plus embedded Palo Alto Test A Site.
• Ctrl+mouse wheel zooms result tables/text; live Cisco/real-key and clean-machine acceptance remain open.

• Added Subnet Cal with one-field CIDR/dotted-mask input, automatic calculation and incomplete/invalid syntax feedback.
• Added DNS Resolver with selectable records and DNS servers, including NS/SOA, and bounded MACVendors.com vendor lookup.
• Removed Diagnostics, old DNS/HTTP tests and Network Info/Wi-Fi Manager from the desktop; Port Test is TCP-only.
• Added the in-app URL Checker layout; live VirusTotal/Palo Alto integration awaits provider accounts/keys and a supported Palo Alto API.

• Added DNS Test with selected record types, direct resolver comparison and bounded UDP/TCP queries.
• Added HTTP/HTTPS Test with response status, redirects, measured header time, TLS/certificate details and normal certificate validation.
• Grouped sidebar navigation with outline icons and pending pages; History/Reports and broader Network Info remain deferred.
• Corrected Dark theme version labels and native window/taskbar branding; preserves the existing Wi-Fi page.

• Added Network Info Wi-Fi Profile Manager with compact searchable/configurable Windows profile tables, explicit scan/connect/disconnect and safe import/export.
• Windows-managed Personal/EAP/certificate authentication; optional PEAP app credentials use Windows Credential Manager.
• Configured source-aware Gateway/DNS/TCP/HTTP Connect & Test, bounded measured history and network transition notices.
• Retains all 0.4.2 diagnostics fixes; Wi-Fi tables support selectable text and update preparation drains Wi-Fi work.
• Actual Wi-Fi/Enterprise hardware authentication still requires acceptance on a Wi-Fi-capable machine.

• Pace Live Ping at up to 128 sends/s and reserve separate Traceroute capacity; large scopes run at a safe effective interval.
• Warn explains current RTT, missing replies or recent loss; cumulative loss remains accurate.
• Added actual Reply IP Address to Ping results and Host / Reply IP Address to history.
• Select and copy text in table cells and headers, or copy/select complete visible tables; Port Test retains configurable columns.
• Optional per-session TCP checks on responding hop IPs, with common/custom ports and actual successful ports in results.

• Removed redundant caption labels; fixed dark caret/session text and template button spacing.
• Moved Hop Description beside the result filter and stabilized the Running label.
• Port Test always scans multiple targets continuously; supports inclusive port ranges such as 1000-1005.
• Configurable TCP/UDP payload size, default 32 bytes (0–1400); TCP records successful sends without claiming an application response.

• Supplied NetStucked branding, Light/Dark/System themes and themed popups.
• Smooth menu/panel toggles, resizing, input guides and semantic status colors.
• Shared IP hop descriptions, cached public WAN ASN metadata and five trace sessions with a protected main session.
• Separate TCP/UDP port input, Host/IP/CIDR × ports, single-pass/continuous checkbox and editable saved/restorable common-port templates.
• Large scan acknowledgement; UDP silence remains inconclusive.

• Added a published-build selector and one action to install, reinstall or recover the chosen version.
• Verify GitHub installer identity, SHA-256, size, product version and Windows trust; unsigned builds require acknowledgement.
• Stop diagnostics, preserve versioned settings backups and restart through an isolated helper.
• Keep Windows permission prompts and manual release links; no background installation.

• Added TCP Port Test with independent endpoint polling, pause/resume, templates, connection history and CSV export.
• Added manual GitHub Releases checks, release notes and a manual recovery guide.
• Moved Settings and Updates to the bottom application group in the sidebar.

• Introduced real multi-target ICMP Live Ping and continuous TTL-based ICMP Traceroute.
• Added CIDR input, named address templates, trace address history and independent trace sessions.
• Improved independent scheduling, bounded DNS/probe workers and UI update batching.
• Added compact probe settings, result timestamps, configurable columns, fit/resize guides and stable history scrolling.
• Corrected maximized window bounds and introduced minimal window controls.
• Added .NET 10 Windows self-contained publishing and the Inno Setup installer foundation.
